description:
Create a reusable work item template for the 'TailwindTraders' team to standardize bug reporting.

Your task:
1. Open the TailwindTraders project in Azure DevOps.
2. Create a new Bug work item template named 'Frontend Bug Report'.
3. Configure the template to pre-fill the following fields:
   - Title: '[Frontend] <short description>'
   - Priority: 2
   - Severity: 2 - High
   - Area Path: TailwindTraders
   - Tags: 'frontend', 'needs-triage'
   - Repro Steps (or Description): A markdown template containing '**Environment:**', '**Steps to Reproduce:**', '**Expected Result:**', and '**Actual Result:**'.
4. Save the template so it is available for the team.
